title: CID Arrests Coaching-Centre Operator and JSSC-CGL 'Fixer' in Widening Exam-Fraud Probe
detail: Jharkhand's CID arrests Sanjeet Kumar, who ran Ranchi's Shivangan Coaching Centre, from the city's Ratu Road area on allegations he collected fees from JPSC candidates while promising to fix their results (Case No. 16/2026). In the parallel JSSC-CGL case (No. 01/2025), the agency separately arrests Dilip Kumar Paswan in West Burdwan, West Bengal, for allegedly providing improper assistance to multiple candidates; he is remanded to judicial custody.

media.caption: CID arrests coaching-centre operator Sanjeet Kumar and JSSC-CGL 'fixer' Dilip Kumar Paswan, Sep 15, 2026.
